## Data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("new_dataset.csv") 
df[is.na(df)] <- 0

factor_vars <- c(
  "mcc",
  "gender",
  "merchant_id",
  "state_abbr",
  "card_brand",
  "card_type",
  "month",
  "time_of_day"
)
for (v in intersect(factor_vars, names(df))) {
  df[[v]] <- factor(df[[v]])
}

df <- df |>
  filter(amount > 0) |>
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c("12", "1", "2")  ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c("3",  "4", "5")  ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c("6",  "7", "8")  ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c("9", "10", "11") ~ "Fall",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    season = factor(season)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    log_amount = log(amount + 1),
    log_income = log(yearly_income + 1),
    log_time_since = log(time_since_last_txn + 1),
    log_total_debt = log(total_debt + 1),
    log_credit_limit = log(credit_limit + 1)
  )
  
df$season <- relevel(df$season, ref = "Summer")
```

```{r}
con <- c("amount", "current_age", "time_since_last_txn",
         "yearly_income", "credit_limit", "pin_age_years", "total_debt",
         "credit_score", "num_cards_issued", "account_age_years", 
         "num_credit_cards", "is_fraud")
df_long <- df[, con] |>
  pivot_longer(names_to = "variable", values_to ="value", cols = -"is_fraud")
df_binned <- df_long %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(bin = ntile(value, 10)) %>% 
  group_by(variable, bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_x = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),      
    prob_fraud = mean(is_fraud, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(df_binned, aes(x = mean_x, y = prob_fraud)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "Fraud Rate (Probability)", x = "Mean of Variable (Binned)",
       title = "Binned Analysis: Checking for Linearity") +
  theme_bw()
```

## GLM Model

### Fit Model

```{r}
df$card_brand <- relevel(df$card_brand, ref = "Discover")
mod_GLM <- glm(
  is_fraud ~
    log_amount +
    log_time_since +
    log_income +
    log_total_debt +
    credit_score +
    num_credit_cards +
    num_cards_issued +
    log_credit_limit +
    season +
    current_age +
    account_age_years +
    pin_age_years +
    gender +
    card_brand +
    card_type +
    time_of_day,
  data    = df,
  family  = binomial()
)

summary(mod_GLM)
```

### Figure 2 in Section 5.1

```{r, warning = FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=7}
coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(mod_GLM)$coefficients)
coef_df$Term <- rownames(coef_df)

inference_df <- coef_df %>%
  filter(Term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(Estimate),
    Lower_CI = exp(Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
    Upper_CI = exp(Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
    Significance = ifelse(`Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(OR))

ggplot(inference_df, 
       aes(x = OR, y = reorder(Term, OR), color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower_CI, xmax = Upper_CI), height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-1, 2.5, by = 1), 
    limits = c(-1, 2.5)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", 
                                "Not Significant" = "black")) +
  labs(
    title = "Forest Plot of Fraud Risk Factors (Odds Ratios)",
    subtitle = "OR>1 indicates higher fraud risk; OR<1 indicates lower risk",
    x = "Odds Ratio (log scale)",
    y = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Numerical Simulation

### Simulate the data

```{r}
#Functions for nonlinear scenario
f1 <- function(x) 2.0 * sin(4 * pi * x)              
f2 <- function(x) {
  -4 * (x - 0.25)^2 + 3 * exp(-40 * (x - 0.75)^2)
}

simulate_data <- function(N =2000, scenario=c("linear", "nonlinear", "nonlinear_RE")){
    scenario <- match.arg(scenario)
   
    x1 <- rnorm(N, 0, 1)
    x2 <- rnorm(N, 0, 1)
   
    # Set up grouping structure for random effects
    n_group  <- 100
    group_id <- factor(sample(seq_len(n_group), N, replace = TRUE))
   
   
    if (scenario == "linear") {
        eta <- -3 + 2 * x1 - 1.5 * x2    
    } else if (scenario == "nonlinear"){  
        eta <- -3 + f1(x1) + f2(x2)    
       
    } else if (scenario == "nonlinear_RE") {
   
        eta_mean <- -3 + f1(x1) + f2(x2)
       
        sigma_group <- 2
        u_group     <- rnorm(n_group, mean = 0, sd = sigma_group)
       
        eta <- eta_mean + u_group[group_id]
   
    } else {
        stop("Unknown scenario")
    }
   
    p <- plogis(eta)
    y <- rbinom(N, size=1, prob=p)
   
    data.frame(y=y, x1=x1, x2=x2, p_true=p, group_id = group_id)
}
```

### Fit and Score the Models

```{r}
fit_and_score <- function(df) {
    n <- nrow(df)
    id <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.7 * n))
    train <- df[id,]
    test <- df[-id,]
   
    mod_glm <- glm(y ~ x1 + x2, data=train, family = binomial())
   
    mod_gam <- bam(y ~ s(x1, k=10) + s(x2, k=10), data=train, family=binomial(), method="fREML", discrete = TRUE)
   
    mod_gamm <- bam(
        y ~ s(x1, k = 10) + s(x2, k = 10) + s(group_id, bs = "re"),
        data   = train,
        family = binomial(),
        method = "fREML",
        discrete = TRUE
      )
   
    glm_pred <- predict(mod_glm, newdata = test, type="response")
    gam_pred <- predict(mod_gam, newdata = test, type="response")
    gamm_pred <- predict(mod_gamm, newdata = test, type="response")
   
    auc_glm <- as.numeric(roc(test$y, glm_pred)$auc)
    auc_gam <- as.numeric(roc(test$y, gam_pred)$auc)
    auc_gamm <- as.numeric(roc(test$y, gamm_pred)$auc)
   
    brier_glm <- mean((glm_pred - test$y)^2)
    brier_gam <- mean((gam_pred - test$y)^2)
    brier_gamm <- mean((gamm_pred - test$y)^2)
   
    data.frame(
        model = c("GLM", "GAM", "GAMM"),
        AUC = c(auc_glm, auc_gam, auc_gamm),
        brier = c(brier_glm, brier_gam, brier_gamm)
    )
}
```

### Run Simulations

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
run_sims <- function(n_sims = 100, scenario=c("linear", "nonlinear", "nonlinear_RE"), N = 2000){
    scenario <- match.arg(scenario)
   
    bind_rows(
        replicate(n_sims, {
            df <- simulate_data(N=N, scenario = scenario)
            out <- fit_and_score(df)
            out$scenario <- scenario
            out
        }, simplify = FALSE)
    )
}

res_linear <- run_sims(n_sims = 100, scenario = "linear", N=2000)
res_nonlinear <- run_sims(n_sims = 100, scenario = "nonlinear", N=2000)
res_nonlinear_RE <- run_sims(n_sims = 100, scenario = "nonlinear_RE", N=2000)

all_res <- bind_rows(res_linear, res_nonlinear, res_nonlinear_RE)
```

### Figure 5 & 6 in Section 6.3

```{r}
plot_df <- all_res %>%
  group_by(scenario, model) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_AUC   = mean(AUC),
    sd_AUC     = sd(AUC),
    mean_Brier = mean(brier),
    sd_Brier   = sd(brier),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("GLM", "GAM", "GAMM"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_AUC, sd_AUC, mean_Brier, sd_Brier),
    names_to   = c("stat", "metric"),
    names_sep  = "_",
    values_to  = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = "stat",
    values_from = "value"
  )

plot_auc <- plot_df %>%
  filter(metric == "AUC") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = mean, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Mean AUC",
    title = "Simulation results: AUC by model and scenario",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

plot_brier <- plot_df %>%
  filter(metric == "Brier") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = mean, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Mean Brier score",
    title = "Simulation results: Brier score by model and scenario",
    fill = "Model",
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

plot_auc
plot_brier
```

```{r}
n0 <- sum(df$is_fraud == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n1 <- sum(df$is_fraud == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
w <- ifelse(df$is_fraud == 1, n0/n1, 1)
gam_weight <- bam(
  is_fraud ~ 
    credit_score +
    num_credit_cards +
    num_cards_issued +
    current_age +
    account_age_years +
    pin_age_years +
    gender + 
    card_brand +

    s(log_amount, k = 20) +

    s(log_credit_limit, k = 30) +
    s(log_time_since, k = 20),
  data    = df,
  family  = binomial(),
  method  = "fREML",
  discrete = TRUE,
  weight = w
)

df_used <- model.frame(gam_weight)
df_used$resid <- residuals(gam_weight, type = "pearson")
keep_rows <- as.numeric(rownames(model.frame(gam_weight)))

df_clean$resid <- residuals(gam_weight, type = "pearson")

merchant_check <- df_clean %>% 
  group_by(merchant_id) %>%
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
df$season <- relevel(df$season, ref = "Summer")
gamm_weight <- bam(
  is_fraud ~
    credit_score +
    num_credit_cards +
    num_cards_issued +
    current_age +
    account_age_years +
    pin_age_years +
    gender +
    card_brand +
    card_type +
    season +
    time_of_day +
    s(log_amount,       k = 20) +
    s(log_income,       k = 40) +
    s(log_total_debt,   k = 70) +
    s(log_time_since,   k = 30) +
    s(log_credit_limit, k = 35) +
    s(merchant_id, bs = "re") +
    s(mcc,         bs = "re") +
    s(state_abbr,  bs = "re"),
  data      = df,
  family    = binomial(),
  method    = "fREML",
  discrete  = TRUE,
  nthreads  = 4,
  na.action = na.exclude,
  weights = w
)
p_hat_gamm <- predict(gamm_weight, type = "response")
roc_gamm <- roc(response = df$is_fraud, predictor = p_hat_gamm, quiet = TRUE)
auc_gamm <- auc(roc_gamm)

plot(roc_gamm, main = sprintf("ROC curve (GAMM) — in-sample AUC = %.3f", auc_gamm))
abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "gray50")

calib_df_gamm <- tibble(
  y     = df$is_fraud,
  p_hat = p_hat_gamm
) %>%
  mutate(bin = ntile(p_hat, 10)) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_p_hat = mean(p_hat),
    obs_rate   = mean(y),
    n          = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(calib_df_gamm, aes(x = mean_p_hat, y = obs_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration plot (GAMM, in-sample)",
    x = "Predicted probability (bin average)",
    y = "Observed fraud rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
